data.rationale: Books can use different punctuation and lexical forms, but attribution text must remain separate from spoken dialogue for audiobook generation.

data.rationale: Local models should help decide who speaks without being able to corrupt block boundaries or source wording.
data.requirement: Speech Blocks AI generation shall ask models to assign speakers to existing atomic unit IDs only, using allowed speaker IDs, confidence, and warning flags, while validation rejects skipped, duplicated, reordered, merged, rewritten, or structurally inconsistent units.

data.rationale: Character attribution quality depends on source-language evidence and deterministic hints, especially for local models and role speakers.
data.requirement: Speech Blocks speaker detection shall use source-language character aliases, role labels, nearby attribution hints, same-speaker continuations, and ambiguity warnings before falling back to narrator defaults.
